headline: The third hour arrives unannounced.
body: Radiators tick once and then remember their manners. A bus two streets over lifts its whole bright body through the dark and is gone. The desk lamp holds a small, private weather.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: indigo without a moon, roofs as silhouettes

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: one lamp, one screen, the rest of the room withheld

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: wet tarmac, a single late bus
